readout_other: von Frey threshold (dynamic aesthesiometer); Iba1 immunohistochemistry; CD86 flow cytometry of spinal microglia
direction_notes: Early tsFUS after sciatic CCI was associated with recovery of von Frey threshold and fewer total and activated (CD86+) microglia ipsilateral to injury versus sham stimulation.
safety_notes: No formal histological safety evaluation; a pilot test in a healthy rat showed no sign of tissue damage with the same protocol; animals were monitored daily for posture changes.

target.label: L5 segment level of the spinal cord

timing.protocol_description: tsFUS delivered for 3 min daily on days 4, 5 and 6 after CCI under isoflurane; sham stimulation in controls.

source_quotes.n_subjects: In a behavioral cohort (N = 6 tsFUS, N = 6 sham), von Frey threshold (VFT) testing was conducted 1 day before CCI (baseline), and at 4, 7, 9, 16 and 23 days after CCI. Some animals were sacrificed for immunohistochemistry (IHC: N = 5 for sham CCI, CCI + tsFUS sham, and CCI + tsFUS) or flow cytometry (FC: N = 5 for sham CCI, N = 4 for CCI + tsFUS sham and CCI + tsFUS), on day 6 after CCI.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: The FUS pulse repetition frequency (PRF) was set to 2 kHz, and the duty cycle was set to 40%. tsFUS treatment was delivered for three minutes daily for three consecutive days Fig. 1.
